messages.subject: ConditionalPanel with radioButtons
parts:
Is there a way to use conditionalPanel with radioButtons? Here is a snippet of my code.  I have gotten it to work with checkboxInput with 1 option, but unsure how to use the conditionalPanel with multiple options.  Thanks!

    radioButtons("edit", "Edit",
                 list("Active Info" = "active",
                      "Delete Info" = "delete")),
             conditionalPanel(
               condition = "input.edit == active",
                                  dataTableOutput("active.info"),
               condition = "input.edit == delete",
                                  uiOutput("delete.list"),
                                  actionButton("delete_portfolio", "Delete Portfolio"),
                                  actionButton("Save_Portfolio","Save Portfolio")
             ),
